location.en: Hallway outside apartment 3B, late at night

goal.en: Ask your neighbor to keep the noise down and agree on a compromise.
goal.zh: 請鄰居降低音量，並談出雙方都能接受的折衷方案。

background: narrow apartment building hallway at night, plain wooden doors, warm wall lamps, patterned carpet runner, a potted plant in the corner, soft yellow light, quiet atmosphere

intro.en: It's 11:30 p.m. You have a test tomorrow, but drums and guitar have been coming through the wall for two hours.
intro.zh: 晚上十一點半。你明天要考試，但隔壁的鼓聲和吉他聲已經穿牆傳來兩個小時了。

intro.en: You take a deep breath and knock on the door of 3B.
intro.zh: 你深吸一口氣，敲了 3B 的門。

lines.en: Hey! Oh, hi. You're the new neighbor, right? What's up?
lines.zh: 嘿！喔，嗨。你是新搬來的鄰居對吧？怎麼了？

choices.en: Hi, I'm Kai from 3A. I hate to bother you, but it's pretty loud.
choices.zh: 嗨，我是 3A 的凱。很不想打擾你，但聲音有點大。
choices.tip: I hate to bother you, but... 先表示歉意再說問題，抱怨也能說得很客氣。

choices.en: Your music is way too loud. Do you have any idea what time it is?
choices.zh: 你的音樂太大聲了。你知道現在幾點嗎？

lines.en: Whoa, okay. Nice to meet you too.
lines.zh: 哇，好喔。我也很高興認識你。

story.en: Nico closes the door a little harder than necessary. The music doesn't stop, and now the hallway feels awkward too.
story.zh: 尼可關門的力道比平常大了一點。音樂沒停，以後在走廊碰面也變得很尷尬。

fail.why: 一開口就質問 Do you have any idea what time it is? 會讓對方立刻防衛。先打招呼、表示歉意：I hate to bother you, but it's pretty loud.

choices.en: Hello, I live next door. Sorry, but your sound is very big tonight.
choices.zh: 你好，我住隔壁。不好意思，你今晚聲音很大。

lines.en: My sound is big? Uh, thanks! We've been practicing a lot.
lines.zh: 我的聲音很宏亮？呃，謝啦！我們最近很認真練習。

story.en: Nico thinks you're praising his band and invites you to their next show. The drumming gets even louder.
story.zh: 尼可以為你在稱讚他的樂團，還邀你去看下一場表演。鼓聲變得更大了。

fail.why: 「聲音很大」不能直譯成 sound is very big，聽起來像在稱讚。抱怨音量要說 It's pretty loud. 或 The music is a bit loud.

lines.en: Oh, sorry! We have a show on Friday, so the band is rehearsing.
lines.zh: 喔，抱歉！我們星期五有表演，所以樂團在排練。

lines.en: Is it really that loud over there?
lines.zh: 你那邊真的有那麼吵嗎？

choices.en: I'm afraid so. Would you mind keeping it down? I have a test tomorrow.
choices.zh: 恐怕是的。你介意小聲一點嗎？我明天要考試。
choices.tip: Would you mind keeping it down? 是請人降低音量的禮貌說法，加上理由更容易被接受。

choices.en: Yes, quite loud. Would you mind to keep it down? I have test tomorrow.
choices.zh: 對，很吵。你介意小聲一點嗎？我明天考試。

lines.en: Would I mind to... what? Sorry, I didn't catch the end of that.
lines.zh: 我介意去……什麼？抱歉，我沒聽到後半句。

story.en: Nico can't hear you over the drums, so he just nods politely. He closes the door, and the band starts the next song.
story.zh: 鼓聲太大，尼可聽不清楚，只好客氣地點點頭。他關上門，樂團開始下一首歌。

fail.why: Would you mind 後面接動名詞 V-ing：Would you mind keeping it down?，不能接 to + 原形動詞。test 前面也要加 a。

choices.en: Oh, no, it's totally fine. You guys play really well, actually.
choices.zh: 喔，不會啦，完全沒關係。其實你們彈得很好。

lines.en: Oh! Thanks! So... was there something else?
lines.zh: 喔！謝啦！所以……還有其他事嗎？

story.en: Nico thanks you for the compliment and goes back to practice. You study with earplugs until two in the morning.
story.zh: 尼可謝謝你的稱讚，回去繼續練習。你戴著耳塞念書到凌晨兩點。

fail.why: 台灣人習慣委婉暗示，但說 It's fine 再稱讚對方，鄰居只會以為你是來捧場的。要清楚提出請求：Would you mind keeping it down?

lines.en: Oh man, sorry. But we really need to practice. The show is in three days.
lines.zh: 唉，抱歉。但我們真的需要練習，表演只剩三天了。

lines.en: What if we play for just one more hour?
lines.zh: 那我們再練一個小時就好，怎麼樣？

choices.en: How about stopping by ten on weeknights? Weekends are fine with me.
choices.zh: 平日晚上十點前停，好嗎？週末我都沒問題。
choices.tip: How about...? 提出折衷方案，讓雙方都有台階下。

choices.en: One more hour? No way. Stop right now, or I'm calling the police.
choices.zh: 再一個小時？不可能。現在就停，不然我報警。

lines.en: The police? Seriously? Okay, fine. Wow.
lines.zh: 報警？你認真的？好啦，算了。真是的。

story.en: The music stops, and so do Nico's friendly hellos. Whenever you meet in the hallway, he suddenly finds his phone very interesting.
story.zh: 音樂停了，尼可友善的招呼也跟著停了。之後在走廊碰到，他總是突然對手機很感興趣。

fail.why: 第一次溝通就威脅報警，鄰居關係會直接破裂。先提出折衷：How about stopping by ten on weeknights?

choices.en: How about you stop at ten? And in weekend, you can play more late.
choices.zh: 你們十點停好不好？週末可以玩晚一點。

lines.en: Play more late? Wait, so later is better? I'm lost.
lines.zh: 玩更晚？等等，所以越晚越好？我搞不懂了。

story.en: Nico thinks you want them to play later, so the band rehearses until one in the morning every Saturday.
story.zh: 尼可以為你希望他們練晚一點，結果樂團每個星期六都排練到凌晨一點。

fail.why: 「晚一點」是 later，不是 more late；「週末」要說 on weekends。可以說 How about stopping by ten on weeknights? You can play later on weekends.

lines.en: Ten on weeknights? Yeah, that's fair. I'll tell the band.
lines.zh: 平日十點？嗯，很公平。我會跟團員說。

lines.en: Hey, sorry again. Come to our show on Friday if you want!
lines.zh: 嘿，再說一次抱歉。想來的話星期五來看我們表演吧！

choices.en: Thanks for understanding. I'd love to come if I'm free.
choices.zh: 謝謝你的體諒。有空的話我很樂意去。
choices.tip: Thanks for understanding. 為對方的配合道謝，讓這次抱怨有個溫暖的結尾。

choices.en: Thank you for your cooperation. I will think about it.
choices.zh: 謝謝你的配合。我會考慮看看。

lines.en: My cooperation? Uh, you sound like the building manager.
lines.zh: 我的配合？呃，你講話好像管理員喔。

story.en: Nico tells the band that 3A is "kind of scary, like a teacher." The Friday invitation quietly disappears.
story.zh: 尼可跟團員說 3A 的鄰居「有點可怕，像老師一樣」。星期五的邀請就這樣默默取消了。

fail.why: 「謝謝你的配合」直譯成 Thank you for your cooperation. 像公告或客服的口吻，對鄰居太生硬。說 Thanks for understanding. 自然又友善。

choices.en: No, my test is tomorrow, not Friday. Please remember that.
choices.zh: 不是，我是明天考試，不是星期五。請記住。

lines.en: Oh, I know. I meant our show... never mind.
lines.zh: 喔，我知道。我是說我們的表演……算了。

story.en: Nico decides you're too busy for fun and never asks again. Later you hear the show was amazing.
story.zh: 尼可覺得你太忙，沒空玩，之後再也沒邀過你。後來你聽說那場表演超精彩。

fail.why: 對方是在邀請你看表演，不是在問考試日期。回應邀請可以說 I'd love to come if I'm free.

lines.en: Deal. Good luck on your test, neighbor!
lines.zh: 一言為定。考試加油啊，鄰居！

lines.en: Ten minutes later, the building is quiet.
lines.zh: 十分鐘後，整棟樓安靜了下來。

story.en: You study until midnight in perfect silence. On Friday, you even go to the show and cheer for Nico's band.
story.zh: 你在一片寧靜中念書到半夜。星期五，你還真的去看了表演，替尼可的樂團加油。

notes.en: I hate to bother you, but...
notes.explain: 開口抱怨或請求前的緩衝語。先表示歉意，對方比較願意聽下去。

example.en: I hate to bother you, but your car is blocking my door.
example.zh: 很不想打擾你，但你的車擋到我家門口了。

notes.explain: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing。回答「不介意」要說 No, not at all.，因為字面意思是「你介意嗎」。

example.en: Would you mind turning the TV down a little?
example.zh: 你介意把電視轉小聲一點嗎？

notes.explain: 提出折衷方案的好用句型，後面接 V-ing 或名詞。比直接拒絕對方的提議更容易談成。

example.en: How about practicing in the afternoon instead?

notes.en: It's loud. / The sound is big.
notes.explain: 聲音大小用 loud / quiet，不用 big / small。請人調小聲說 turn it down 或 keep it down。

example.en: The music is too loud. Could you turn it down?
example.zh: 音樂太大聲了，可以轉小聲一點嗎？

notes.explain: 台灣人習慣委婉暗示，但在楓灣，客套話常被照字面理解。抱怨鄰居時語氣要友善、請求要清楚，最好還能提出折衷方案。

example.en: It's a bit loud for me. Would ten o'clock work for you?
example.zh: 對我來說有點吵。十點前停，你可以嗎？
